text: ‘Globalisation has led to cultural convergence.’ Evaluate this view. [35]

‘Modernisation theory provides the best explanation of global inequality.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
Section B: Media
EITHER
‘Governments have no control over the media.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘The two-step flow model accurately describes how people are influenced by the media.’ Evaluate
this view. [35]
Section C: Religion
EITHER
‘Religion contributes to gender inequality.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘The extent to which secularisation has occurred has been exaggerated.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
